name: StEvo-Bench
description:
STEVO-Bench
	

STEVO-Bench evalutes whether video world models can “simulate” a world beyond the pixel frame. 
We introduce observation control such as occlusion, camera lookaway or illumination dimming to prove whether video world models can evolve state successfully
Visit the STEVO-Bench official site to see leaderboard, example tasks and example videos. 
Read our paper and blog post to see our findings and discussions about SOTA video world models!

reputation: A recent benchmark that has attracted interest from the video world-modeling community for evaluating models under challenging observation-control conditions.
